title: Show the search match alongside typed error reasons with bounded session-row height
outcome: Show the search match alongside typed error reasons with bounded session-row height
acceptance: When a typed full error reason is available, an Error-filtered search result exposes both that reason and the matching search context without inferring a current error from historical transcript text.
Long or multiline typed reasons have bounded row presentation with a way to inspect the complete reason; regression coverage checks search context and long reasons.
